spans: the problem was never the volume.
You are sending the same message to people who want different things,
so it reads as a template to every one of them.

items: You do not need a bigger list.
You do not need a new sending tool.
You need the first line to be about them.

spans: One line of real research per prospect
changes the reply rate more than doubling the send volume ever will.
It takes about 90 seconds a prospect.
Most people will not do it.
